lessons.title: Single Leg Barbell Hip Thrust
lessons.details: Sit with your upper back against a bench, barbell across your hips, and one foot planted on the ground. Lift hips by driving through the heel, extending until hips are level, while the other leg stays raised. Lower with control.

lessons.title: Barbell Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with the balls of your feet on a raised surface, heels hanging off. Hold a barbell across your upper back. Push through the balls of your feet to lift your heels as high as possible, then slowly lower back down.

lessons.title: Assisted Chin Up Machine
lessons.details: Set the desired assistance on the machine, grip the bar with palms facing you (underhand), and place knees or feet on the pad. Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar, then lower with control. Reduce assistance as you get stronger.

lessons.title: Assisted Pull Up Machine
lessons.details: Adjust the weight stack to set assistance, grip the handles, and place knees or feet on the pad. Pull yourself up smoothly until your chin is over the bar, then lower with control. Reduce assistance as strength improves.

lessons.title: Back Extension Machine
lessons.details: Adjust the pad to align with your hips, position your feet securely, and cross your arms over your chest. Lower your torso slowly, then extend your back to lift your chest until aligned with your legs. Avoid hyperextending.

lessons.title: Cable Hip Abduction
lessons.details: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable. Stand sideways to the machine, strap around the outer ankle. Keeping the supporting leg slightly bent, lift the strapped leg outward against resistance. Control the return and repeat for desired reps.

lessons.title: Cable Lateral Raise
lessons.details: Start the Cable Lateral Raise standing with your back to the cable machine. Put both heads in the low position. Then with both hands at your side grab a handle with each hand. Then keeping your arms locked out raise your arms away from you sideways until your arms are just above shoulder level.

lessons.title: Cable Machine Bicep Curl
lessons.details: Start the Cable Rope Curl with the cable head in the low position. Then hook the rope attachment up to the cable. Grab the rope with both hands. Keepy your elbows at your side and curl your hands up to your shoulders. Then lower the rope to the bottom position.

lessons.title: Cable Machine Kickback
lessons.details: Attach an ankle strap to the cable machine at the lowest setting. Face the machine, hinge slightly forward, and extend one leg straight back against resistance. Control the return and repeat before switching sides. Engages glutes and hamstrings.

lessons.title: Cable Oblique Rotation High to Low
lessons.details: Start the High to Low Cable Oblique Rotation with the cable head in the top position. Grab an attachment with both hands. Stand perpendicular to the cable machine in the split position. Then pull the attachment from the top of the cable head to the bottom of your opposite side keeping your arms locked out.

lessons.title: Cable Oblique Rotation Low to High
lessons.details: Start the Low to High Cable Oblique Rotation with the cable head in the low position. Then with both hands grab the rope that's attached to the cable head. Then pull the cable from the bottom on your side to the top of your other side. Then return it to the starting position.

lessons.title: Cable Oblique Twist
lessons.details: Attach a handle to a cable machine at chest height. Stand sideways to the machine, feet shoulder-width apart. Hold the handle with both hands and rotate your torso away from the machine, keeping arms extended. Slowly return to start and repeat for reps, then switch sides.

lessons.title: Cable Tricep Pulldown
lessons.details: Start the Rope Cable Tricep Pushdown standing facing the cable machine. Then keeping your elbows at your side push the rope until your elbows lock out. Then return it to the starting position.

lessons.title: Chest Press Machine
lessons.details: Sit on the chest press machine with back against the pad and hands on the handles. Press the handles forward until arms are fully extended, keeping elbows slightly bent. Slowly return to start with control, engaging chest and triceps.

lessons.title: Hamstring Curl Machine
lessons.details: Sit or lie on the hamstring curl machine, positioning the pad just above your heels or ankles. Keep your back flat against the support, then curl your legs down by engaging your hamstrings. Slowly return to the starting position with control, avoiding momentum.

lessons.title: Hip Abduction Machine
lessons.details: Sit on the hip abduction machine with your back supported and feet on the pads. Begin with knees together, then press your legs outward against resistance. Control the return inward to keep tension on the muscles. Targets glutes and outer thighs.

lessons.title: Hip Adduction Machine
lessons.details: Sit on the hip adduction machine with your back against the pad and feet secured on the footrests. Start with legs apart, then squeeze your thighs together against the resistance. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

lessons.title: Lat Pull Down Machine
lessons.details: Sit at the lat pulldown machine with your feet flat and knees under the pad. Grasp the bar with a wide overhand grip, pull it down toward your chest while keeping your back straight and shoulders down, then slowly return to the starting position.

lessons.title: Leg Extension Machine
lessons.details: Sit on the leg extension machine with your knees aligned to the pivot point and the pad just above your ankles. Grip the handles, then extend your legs until straight. Slowly lower back down with control, keeping tension in your quads throughout.

lessons.title: Leg Press Machine
lessons.details: Sit on the leg press machine with your back against the pad and feet shoulder-width on the platform. Push the platform away by extending your legs, then slowly lower it back without locking your knees. Maintain control and engage your legs throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Leg Press Machine - Single Leg Calf Raises
lessons.details: Place one foot on the leg press platform with your heel off the edge. Press through the ball of your foot to lift your heel, then slowly lower back down. Keep your core engaged and control the movement. Repeat on the other leg.

lessons.title: Reverse Sled Drag
lessons.details: Face the sled, grab the straps or handles, and step backward with knees slightly bent and chest tall. Drive through your legs to pull the sled toward you, keeping tension on the straps throughout.

lessons.title: Seated Cable Row
lessons.details: Start the Seated Rope Cable Row sitting on a bench in front of the cable machine. Then put the cable head in the middle position and attach the rope attachment. Grab the rope with each hand and row your hands to your armpit. Then return it to the starting position.

lessons.title: Single Leg Extension Machine
lessons.details: Sit on a leg extension machine with one leg positioned under the pad. Keep your back against the seat and grip the handles. Extend your leg fully, squeezing the quadriceps at the top, then lower slowly with control. Switch sides and repeat.

lessons.title: Single Leg Hamstring Curl Machine
lessons.details: Sit upright, core engaged, on the hamstring curl machine. Place one ankle under the roller pad and keep hips pressed into the back pad. Curl your heel down toward your glutes, squeezing your hamstring, then lower slowly with control. Switch legs and repeat.

lessons.title: Single Leg Press
lessons.details: Sit on a leg press machine and place one foot centered on the platform. Keep your other leg relaxed. Push through your heel to extend the working leg without locking the knee, then slowly return under control. Maintain steady breathing and core engagement.

lessons.title: Sled Push
lessons.details: Stand behind the sled with hands on the handles, body leaning slightly forward, and core tight. Drive through your legs to push the sled forward with powerful, steady strides. Maintain control and consistent effort throughout.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Step Up
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell at chest level in a goblet position, place one foot firmly on a box or bench, and drive through the heel to step up. Bring the other leg up, then lower slowly and repeat.

lessons.title: Step Up
lessons.details: Place one foot firmly on a box or bench, drive through the heel to lift your body up, bringing the opposite knee up or stepping fully onto the surface. Lower with control and repeat on the other side.

lessons.title: Slow Eccentric Lateral Step Downs
lessons.details: Stand on a box or step with one foot planted and the other hanging off the side. Slowly lower the hanging foot toward the ground by bending the standing leg, then return to the start with control.

lessons.title: Box Step up with Knee Drive
lessons.details: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench. Step onto it with one foot, driving the opposite knee upward as you rise. Step back down with control and alternate legs. Keep core engaged and torso upright throughout.

lessons.title: Lateral Box Step Down
lessons.details: Stand beside a bench or box. Step sideways onto it with your outer foot, driving through the heel to lift your body up. Bring the trailing leg to meet the lead leg, then step back down with control. Repeat on both sides.

lessons.title: Lateral Step Up
lessons.details: Stand beside a bench or box. Step sideways onto it with your outer foot, driving through the heel to lift your body up. Bring the trailing leg to meet the lead leg, then step back down with control. Repeat on both sides.

lessons.title: Front Step Downs
lessons.details: Stand on a raised platform with one foot, step forward and down slowly, keeping the other foot off the ground. Maintain control and balance, then return to start and switch legs. Focus on engaging quads and glutes throughout.

lessons.title: Side Step Downs
lessons.details: Stand on a step or platform with one foot. Slowly lower the opposite foot toward the ground by bending the standing leg, keeping control. Lightly tap the foot down, then press through the elevated foot to return to start. Maintain balance and avoid leaning forward.

lessons.title: Lateral Powerbag Step Up
lessons.details: Stand side-on to a box or bench holding the powerbag tight at your chest (or on one shoulder). Place the foot closest to the box on top with your knee tracking over your toes, brace your core, then drive through that whole foot to step up powerfully and stand tall. Step back down under control to the same side, repeat for reps, then turn around and do the other side.

lessons.title: Bosu Ball Squat
lessons.details: Stand on a BOSU ball with feet shoulder-width apart, core engaged. Lower into a squat by bending your knees and pushing hips back, keeping chest upright. Drive through your heels to return to standing, maintaining balance throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Bosu Ball Hip Stride
lessons.details: Lunge forwards into a hip flexor stretch position, with front foot on the Bosu ball and the other on the floor. Step forward or backward with control, keeping your core engaged and hips level. Focus on balance and smooth movement throughout each stride.

lessons.title: Bosu Ball Split Squat
lessons.details: Place your rear foot on a BOSU ball and front foot firmly on the floor. Lower into a split squat by bending your front knee while keeping chest tall. Push through the front heel to rise back up, maintaining balance and control.

lessons.title: Bosu Ball Rear Leg Split Squat
lessons.details: Place one foot on the Bosu ball behind you, ball side down, and the other foot firmly on the floor. Lower your back knee toward the ground, keeping your front knee over your ankle. Push through your front heel to return to standing.

lessons.title: Bosu Ball Double Leg Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with both feet on the Bosu ball, heels hanging off the edge. Rise onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly below the level of the Bosu. Keep your core tight and balance steady throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Bosu Ball Single Leg Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one foot on the Bosu ball, keeping your core tight for balance. Push through your toes to lift your heel, then slowly lower back down. Maintain control and stability throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Banded Plantar Flexion
lessons.details: Sit with a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding the resistance band taught. Press your toes away from your body, extending your ankle fully, then slowly return to start. Keep the movement controlled to engage your calves effectively.

lessons.title: Seated Banded Dorsiflexion
lessons.details: Sit with one leg extended and loop a band around the ball of one foot and an external anchor point. Flex your foot upward toward your shin against the band, then slowly release. Repeat for controlled reps to strengthen ankles and shins.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Double Leg Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Engage your core and press down through the balls of both feet, lifting your heels as high as possible. Pause briefly at the top, then lower your heels slowly and with control. This bodyweight exercise strengthens the gastrocnemius and soleus muscles, enhancing ankle stability and running power.

lessons.title: Eccentric Single-Leg Heel Drops
lessons.details: Stand on the edge of a step with your heels hanging off. Raise both heels, then stand on one leg and slowly lower yourself on one leg to below the step level, over 3–5 seconds. Keep your calves engaged and control the movement throughout. Use the supporting leg to return to the first position and repeat.

lessons.title: Single Leg Elevated Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one leg on an elevated surface with your knee slightly bent. Lower your heel below the platform, then press up through the ball of your foot, engaging the soleus. Slowly return to the start position, maintaining control throughout the movement

lessons.title: Toe Walks
lessons.details: Stand tall on the balls of your feet and walk forward, keeping heels lifted. Maintain a steady pace, core engaged, and shoulders relaxed. Focus on controlled steps to strengthen calves, ankles, and improve balance.

lessons.title: Double Leg Bodyweight Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with both heels on the ground, knees slightly bent. Raise your heels by pressing through the balls of your feet, pause at the top, then lower slowly to engage the soleus.

lessons.title: Double Leg Elevated Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on an elevated surface with both heels hanging off the edge. Assume a half-squat position with bent knees. Raise your heels by pressing through the balls of your feet, pause at the top, then lower slowly to stretch the soleus.

lessons.title: Single Leg Bodyweight Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one leg with your knee slightly bent. Lower your heel toward the ground, then lift up onto the ball of your foot, engaging the soleus. Perform the movement slowly and with control, keeping balance throughout.

lessons.title: Single Leg Weighted Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee, holding a weight in one or each hand. Raise your heel by pushing through the ball of your foot, then slowly lower back down. Focus on controlled movement to engage the soleus muscle

lessons.title: Double Leg Elevated Weighted Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on an elevated surface holding weights, heels hanging off the edge. Assume a half-squat position with bent knees. Press through the balls of both feet to lift your heels, pause at the top, then lower slowly to stretch the soleus

lessons.title: Double Leg Weighted Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with feet hip width apart, holding a weight at each side. Bend the knees into a half-squat. Push through the balls of your feet, raising your heels. Lower slowly, feeling the soleus stretch.

lessons.title: Double Leg Goblet Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Hold a goblet weight at chest height, assume a half-squat posution, and lift your heels by pressing through the balls of your feet. Lower slowly, engaging the soleus.

lessons.title: Eccentric Heel Drops
lessons.details: Stand on the edge of a step with heels hanging off. Rise up onto both feet, then lift one foot and slowly lower the other heel below the step level to stretch and strengthen the calf. Use both feet to return to start.

lessons.title: Single Leg Bodyweight Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one leg with your foot flat on the ground. Slowly lift your heel as high as possible, engaging your calf, then lower with control. Keep balance and avoid leaning forward.

lessons.title: Single Leg Goblet Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell close to your chest in a goblet position while standing on one leg with a slightly bent knee. Raise your heel by pushing through the ball of your foot, then slowly lower back down, keeping control throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Double Legged Heel Drops
lessons.details: Stand on the edge of a step with both heels hanging off. Rise up onto your toes, then slowly lower both heels below the step level to stretch and strengthen the calves. Return to the starting position with control.

lessons.title: Single Leg Weighted Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one leg holding a weight on the same side. Keep your core engaged and rise onto the ball of the working foot, lifting your heel as high as possible. Slowly lower back down and repeat for the desired reps.

lessons.title: Heels Elevated Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with balls of feet on an elevated surface, heels hanging off. Engage core and glutes for stability. Press through toes, lifting heels as high as possible. Pause, squeeze calves, then lower slowly below platform level for full stretch. Maintain balance and steady breathing.

lessons.title: Single Legged Heel Drops
lessons.details: Stand on a step with one foot, heel hanging off the edge. Rise up on both feet, then lift the non-working leg. Slowly lower the working heel below the step to stretch and strengthen the calf. Return to start and repeat.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Double Leg Calf Raise
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell in one or both hands at your sides. Stand with feet hip-width apart, core engaged. Press through the balls of your feet, lifting heels as high as possible. Pause, squeeze calves, then lower slowly with control, maintaining balance and steady breathing throughout.

lessons.title: Calf Raise with Activated Glutes
lessons.details: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, core engaged. Lunge forwards into a split-squat. Press through the balls of your feet, lifting heels slowly until standing on toes. Pause at the top, keeping glutes lightly activated, then lower front heel with control. Repeat, maintaining posture and steady breathing.

lessons.title: Single Leg Elevated Weighted Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one foot on an elevated surface, holding a weight securely. Lower your heel slowly below the platform, then press up through your forefoot, fully engaging your calf. Maintain balance and a tight core throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Elevated Weighted Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on a raised surface with one or two weights held at your side. Lower your heels slowly below the platform, then press up through your forefoot, engaging your calf. Keep your core tight for balance and control throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Single Leg Elevated Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one foot on an elevated surface, letting your heel hang off the edge. Push through the ball of your foot to raise your heel as high as possible, then slowly lower back down. Repeat, then switch legs.

lessons.title: Weighted Toe Walk
lessons.details: Hold a weight in each hand at your sides. Stand tall and walk forward on your tiptoes, keeping core tight and shoulders back. Take controlled steps, maintaining balance and tension in calves throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Barbell Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with the balls of your feet on a raised surface, heels hanging off. Hold a barbell across your upper back. Push through the balls of your feet to lift your heels as high as possible, then slowly lower back down.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Farmer's Carry
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your sides, stand tall with shoulders back, and engage your core. Walk forward slowly and steadily, keeping your posture upright and arms straight, then turn and return. Unless training for a Hyrox it's recommended that you place the kettlebells down before turning to avoid twisting the knee under tension.

lessons.title: Lunge with Knee Drive & Calf Raise
lessons.details: Step into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground. Drive through the front heel to stand, bringing the back knee up toward your chest, then rise onto the ball of the front foot for a calf raise.

lessons.title: Lunge with Knee Drive
lessons.details: Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground. Push through your front heel to rise, driving the back knee up explosively toward your chest. Maintain balance and core engagement. Repeat on both sides for strength and stability.

lessons.title: Wall Sit with Calf Raise
lessons.details: Sit against a wall with knees at 90 degrees. Hold the position and lift your heels off the ground, rising onto your toes, then lower back down. Repeat while keeping your back flat against the wall.

lessons.title: Lunge with Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand tall, step one foot forward into a lunge, keeping front knee over ankle. Lower back knee toward the floor, then push through the front heel to rise. At the full extent of the lunge, lift the heel of the front foot into a calf raise. Return to start and switch sides, maintaining balance and control.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Squat Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out. Lower into a squat by bending knees and pushing hips back. As you rise, press through the balls of your feet to lift heels into a calf raise. Lower heels and repeat, keeping core engaged and movements controlled.

lessons.title: Leg Press Machine - Single Leg Calf Raise
lessons.details: Place one foot on the leg press platform with your heel off the edge. Press through the ball of your foot to lift your heel, then slowly lower back down. Keep your core engaged and control the movement. Repeat on the other leg.

lessons.title: Reverse Sled Drag
lessons.details: Face the sled, grab the straps or handles, and step backward with knees slightly bent and chest tall. Drive through your legs to pull the sled toward you, keeping tension on the straps throughout.

lessons.title: Sled Push
lessons.details: Stand behind the sled with hands on the handles, body leaning slightly forward, and core tight. Drive through your legs to push the sled forward with powerful, steady strides. Maintain control and consistent effort throughout.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Double Leg Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Engage your core and press down through the balls of both feet, lifting your heels as high as possible. Pause briefly at the top, then lower your heels slowly and with control. This bodyweight exercise strengthens the gastrocnemius and soleus muscles, enhancing ankle stability and running power.

lessons.title: Barbell Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with the balls of your feet on a raised surface, heels hanging off. Hold a barbell across your upper back. Push through the balls of your feet to lift your heels as high as possible, then slowly lower back down.

lessons.title: Bosu Ball Double Leg Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with both feet on the Bosu ball, heels hanging off the edge. Rise onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly below the level of the Bosu. Keep your core tight and balance steady throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Bosu Ball Single Leg Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one foot on the Bosu ball, keeping your core tight for balance. Push through your toes to lift your heel, then slowly lower back down. Maintain control and stability throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Double Leg Bodyweight Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with both heels on the ground, knees slightly bent. Raise your heels by pressing through the balls of your feet, pause at the top, then lower slowly to engage the soleus.

lessons.title: Double Leg Elevated Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on an elevated surface with both heels hanging off the edge. Assume a half-squat position with bent knees. Raise your heels by pressing through the balls of your feet, pause at the top, then lower slowly to stretch the soleus.

lessons.title: Double Leg Elevated Weighted Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on an elevated surface holding weights, heels hanging off the edge. Assume a half-squat position with bent knees. Press through the balls of both feet to lift your heels, pause at the top, then lower slowly to stretch the soleus

lessons.title: Double Leg Goblet Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Hold a goblet weight at chest height, assume a half-squat posution, and lift your heels by pressing through the balls of your feet. Lower slowly, engaging the soleus.

lessons.title: Double Leg Weighted Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with feet hip width apart, holding a weight at each side. Bend the knees into a half-squat. Push through the balls of your feet, raising your heels. Lower slowly, feeling the soleus stretch.

lessons.title: Single Leg Bodyweight Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one leg with your knee slightly bent. Lower your heel toward the ground, then lift up onto the ball of your foot, engaging the soleus. Perform the movement slowly and with control, keeping balance throughout.

lessons.title: Single Leg Elevated Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one leg on an elevated surface with your knee slightly bent. Lower your heel below the platform, then press up through the ball of your foot, engaging the soleus. Slowly return to the start position, maintaining control throughout the movement

lessons.title: Single Left Goblet Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell close to your chest in a goblet position while standing on one leg with a slightly bent knee. Raise your heel by pushing through the ball of your foot, then slowly lower back down, keeping control throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Single Leg Weighted Soleus Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee, holding a weight in one or each hand. Raise your heel by pushing through the ball of your foot, then slowly lower back down. Focus on controlled movement to engage the soleus muscle

lessons.title: Single Leg Elevated Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand on one foot on an elevated surface, letting your heel hang off the edge. Push through the ball of your foot to raise your heel as high as possible, then slowly lower back down. Repeat, then switch legs.

lessons.title: Tibialis Raise
lessons.details: Sit or stand with feet flat. Lift your toes toward your shins while keeping heels on the ground. Lower slowly and repeat, focusing on controlled movement to strengthen the tibialis anterior.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Farmer's Carry
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your sides, stand tall with shoulders back, and engage your core. Walk forward slowly and steadily, keeping your posture upright and arms straight, then turn and return. Unless training for a Hyrox it's recommended that you place the kettlebells down before turning to avoid twisting the knee under tension.

lessons.title: Eccentric Single Leg Heel Drops
lessons.details: Stand on the edge of a step with your heels hanging off. Raise both heels, then stand on one leg and slowly lower yourself on one leg to below the step level, over 3–5 seconds. Keep your calves engaged and control the movement throughout. Use the supporting leg to return to the first position and repeat.

lessons.title: Single Legged Heel Drops
lessons.details: Stand on a step with one foot, heel hanging off the edge. Rise up on both feet, then lift the non-working leg. Slowly lower the working heel below the step to stretch and strengthen the calf. Return to start and repeat.

lessons.title: Double Legged Heel Drops
lessons.details: Stand on the edge of a step with both heels hanging off. Rise up onto your toes, then slowly lower both heels below the step level to stretch and strengthen the calves. Return to the starting position with control.

lessons.title: Eccentric Heel Drops
lessons.details: Stand on the edge of a step with heels hanging off. Rise up onto both feet, then lift one foot and slowly lower the other heel below the step level to stretch and strengthen the calf. Use both feet to return to start.

lessons.title: Seated Banded Dorsiflexion
lessons.details: Sit with one leg extended and loop a band around the ball of one foot and an external anchor point. Flex your foot upward toward your shin against the band, then slowly release. Repeat for controlled reps to strengthen ankles and shins.

lessons.title: Banded Plantarflexion
lessons.details: Sit with a resistance band around the ball of your foot, holding the resistance band taught. Press your toes away from your body, extending your ankle fully, then slowly return to start. Keep the movement controlled to engage your calves effectively.

lessons.title: Standing Calf Stretch
lessons.details: Stand upright, and step one foot back. Keep the front leg straight, heel pressed into the ground, and lean forward until you feel a stretch in the calf. Extend the stretch by lifting the toe upwards.

lessons.title: Dynamic Calf Stretch
lessons.details: Assume a downward dog position, legs straight. stretch one heel towards the ground, then the other. Repeat in a controlled, rhythmic motion to dynamically stretch the calves. Switch sides after desired reps.

lessons.title: Wall Calf Stretch
lessons.details: Stand facing a wall, place your hands against it, and step one foot back. Keep the back leg straight with the heel pressed into the floor while bending the front knee. Lean forward until you feel a stretch in the calf. Switch sides after holding.

lessons.title: Standing Tibialis Stretch
lessons.details: Stand tall and place the top of one foot behind you on the floor, toes pointing down. Gently press the toes into the ground to stretch the front of your shin (tibialis anterior). Keep posture upright and hold the stretch before switching sides.

lessons.title: Hamstring Glute Bridge March
lessons.details: Lie on your back, heels dug in, hips lifted into a bridge. Alternate lifting each knee toward your chest while keeping hips high and glutes engaged. Lower each foot back before switching sides.

lessons.title: Lunge with Knee Drive & Calf Raise
lessons.details: Step into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground. Drive through the front heel to stand, bringing the back knee up toward your chest, then rise onto the ball of the front foot for a calf raise.

lessons.title: Lunge with Knee Drive
lessons.details: Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground. Push through your front heel to rise, driving the back knee up explosively toward your chest. Maintain balance and core engagement. Repeat on both sides for strength and stability.

lessons.title: Hamstring Walkout
lessons.details: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Lift your hips into a bridge, then slowly walk your heels forward one step at a time, extending your legs while keeping hips raised. Walk back in to return. Control the movement to target hamstrings.

lessons.title: Reverse Bodyweight Lunge with Twist
lessons.details: Step back into a reverse lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground. Rotate your torso toward your front leg, engaging your core. Return to standing and repeat on the other side, keeping movements controlled and stable.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Lunge with Twist
lessons.details: Stand tall and step one foot forward into a lunge, keeping front knee over ankle. Lower back knee toward the floor, then twist your torso toward the front leg. Return to center and step back. Alternate sides, maintaining balance, engaged core, and controlled movement throughout.

lessons.title: Air Squat
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out. Lower your hips by bending your knees and pushing them outward, keeping your chest up and back straight. Lower until thighs are parallel to the floor, then push through your heels to return to standing. Maintain control throughout.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Squat Pulse
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, chest up, and core engaged. Lower into a squat, and perform one half-rep in between each full rep. Keep weight in your heels, knees tracking over toes, and movements smooth. Maintain squat depth throughout.

lessons.title: Lunge with Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand tall, step one foot forward into a lunge, keeping front knee over ankle. Lower back knee toward the floor, then push through the front heel to rise. At the full extent of the lunge, lift the heel of the front foot into a calf raise. Return to start and switch sides, maintaining balance and control.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Lateral Lunge
lessons.details: Stand tall, step one foot wide to the side, bending that knee while keeping the other leg straight. Push hips back, chest up, and weight on the bent leg’s heel. Push off to return to start. Repeat on the other side.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Single Leg Box Squat
lessons.details: Stand on one leg in front of a box or bench. Lower yourself slowly by bending the knee and hip, keeping your chest upright, until you lightly touch the box. Push through your heel to return to standing, maintaining balance and control.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Box Squat
lessons.details: Stand in front of a box or bench. Sit back slowly until your glutes touch the box, keeping chest up and knees over toes. Push through your heels to stand back up.

lessons.title: Prisoner Squat
lessons.details: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped behind your head. Keep chest up and elbows wide. Lower into a squat by pushing hips back and bending knees. Drive through heels to return to standing, maintaining an upright torso throughout.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Lunge Pulse
lessons.details: Start in a lunge with front knee over ankle, back knee just above the floor. Keep torso upright, core tight. Complete a full lunge with a half-lunge in between as a "pulse" to extend the amount of time under tension. Maintain control, avoid bouncing, and repeat.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Squat Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out. Lower into a squat by bending knees and pushing hips back. As you rise, press through the balls of your feet to lift heels into a calf raise. Lower heels and repeat, keeping core engaged and movements controlled.

lessons.title: Banded Squat
lessons.details: Stand on a resistance band, feet shoulder-width apart, band held over shoulders. Keep a slight bend in knees and core engaged. Hinge at hips, lowering torso forward while keeping back straight. Return to standing by driving hips forward, squeezing glutes at the top with controlled movement.

lessons.title: Seated Banded Hamstring Curl
lessons.details: Sit on a chair with a resistance band looped around your ankle and anchored in front. Keep your thigh still and bend your knee, pulling your heel back toward the chair against the band. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for controlled reps

lessons.title: Goblet Squat
lessons.details: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, lower your hips back and down into a squat, keeping your chest up and knees tracking over toes. Press through your heels to return to standing.

lessons.title: Goblet Squat with Calf Raise
lessons.details: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height in a hoblet position. Squat down, keeping chest up and knees over toes. As you rise, press through your toes to lift heels into a calf raise. Lower back down slowly and repeat with controlled motion.

lessons.title: Forwards Goblet Lunge with Twist
lessons.details: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest in a goblet position. Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor. At the bottom, twist your torso outwards over the front leg, keeping hips forwards and twisting the torso only. Return to center, push back up, and alternate sides.

lessons.title: Single Kettlebell Clean and Press
lessons.details: Start with a kettlebell between your feet. Hinge at the hips, grab the bell, and drive through your legs to clean it to shoulder height. From here, press overhead, locking out your arm. Lower with control and repeat for power and coordination.

lessons.title: Barbell Back Squat
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, barbell resting on upper back. Engage core, keep chest up, and gaze forward. Bend knees and hips to lower into a squat, keeping weight on heels. Push through heels to return to standing, maintaining controlled movement and proper alignment throughout.

lessons.title: Barbell Front Load Squat
lessons.details: Hold a barbell at shoulder height, elbows up, chest tall - this can be with a regular or a crossed grip. Step feet shoulder-width apart, squat down by pushing hips back and bending knees, keeping weight on heels. Drive through heels to return to standing, maintaining an upright torso throughout.

lessons.title: Back Extension Machine
lessons.details: Adjust the pad to align with your hips, position your feet securely, and cross your arms over your chest. Lower your torso slowly, then extend your back to lift your chest until aligned with your legs. Avoid hyperextending.

lessons.title: Hamstring Curl Machine
lessons.details: Sit or lie on the hamstring curl machine, positioning the pad just above your heels or ankles. Keep your back flat against the support, then curl your legs down by engaging your hamstrings. Slowly return to the starting position with control, avoiding momentum.

lessons.title: Leg Press Machine
lessons.details: Sit on the leg press machine with your back against the pad and feet shoulder-width on the platform. Push the platform away by extending your legs, then slowly lower it back without locking your knees. Maintain control and engage your legs throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Reverse Sled Drag
lessons.details: Face the sled, grab the straps or handles, and step backward with knees slightly bent and chest tall. Drive through your legs to pull the sled toward you, keeping tension on the straps throughout.

lessons.title: Single Leg Hamstring Curl Machine
lessons.details: Sit upright, core engaged, on the hamstring curl machine. Place one ankle under the roller pad and keep hips pressed into the back pad. Curl your heel down toward your glutes, squeezing your hamstring, then lower slowly with control. Switch legs and repeat.

lessons.title: Single Leg Press Machine
lessons.details: Sit on a leg press machine and place one foot centered on the platform. Keep your other leg relaxed. Push through your heel to extend the working leg without locking the knee, then slowly return under control. Maintain steady breathing and core engagement.

lessons.title: Sled Push
lessons.details: Stand behind the sled with hands on the handles, body leaning slightly forward, and core tight. Drive through your legs to push the sled forward with powerful, steady strides. Maintain control and consistent effort throughout.

lessons.title: Alternating Bodyweight Backwards Lunge
lessons.details: Step one leg back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor. Push through the front heel to return to standing, then switch legs, alternating each step. Keep your torso upright and core engaged throughout.

lessons.title: Alternating Bodyweight Forwards Lunge
lessons.details: Step forward with one leg into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor. Push through the front heel to return and switch legs, alternating each step. Keep your torso upright and core engaged.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Alternating Lunge
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell in one hand at chest level or by your side. Step forward into a lunge, keeping chest tall and core engaged. Push through the front heel to return to standing, then alternate legs. Maintain balance, controlled movement, and steady breathing throughout.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Backwards Lunge
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell one of both hands. Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor while keeping your front knee over your ankle. Push through the front heel to return to standing, maintaining balance and control.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Split Squat
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your side. Step one leg back into a split squat, lowering until front knee is over ankle. Push through the front heel to rise, keeping chest tall and core engaged. Switch sides with control.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Bulgarian Split Squat
lessons.details: Stand in a split stance with back foot on a bench and front foot firmly on the ground. Lower hips until front thigh is parallel to the floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged. Push through front heel to return to start. Switch legs and repeat.

lessons.title: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
lessons.details: Stand in a split stance with back foot on a bench, holding a barbell across your upper back. Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping front knee over ankle. Press through the front heel to rise, maintaining balance, upright torso, and core engagement throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Split Squat Pulse
lessons.details: Start in a split squat position with one foot forward and the other back. Lower into the squat and do one half-rep in between each full rep. Keep your chest tall, core engaged, and weight in the front heel. Repeat before switching legs.

lessons.title: Barbell Split Squat
lessons.details: Stand in a split stance with one foot forward and the other back, holding a barbell across your shoulders. Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright, then drive through your front heel to return to start. Maintain balance and control throughout

lessons.title: Bosu Ball Rear Leg Split Squat
lessons.details: Place one foot on the Bosu ball behind you, ball side down, and the other foot firmly on the floor. Lower your back knee toward the ground, keeping your front knee over your ankle. Push through your front heel to return to standing.

lessons.title: Front Leg Elevated Goblet Split Squat
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell at chest level in a goblet position. Place your front foot on an elevated surface, lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright, then drive through the front heel to return to standing.

lessons.title: Front Leg Elevated Split Squat
lessons.details: Place front foot on an elevated surface and back foot on the ground. Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping chest upright, then press through the front heel to return to standing

lessons.title: Plyometric Split Squat
lessons.details: Start in a split stance with one foot forward, one back. Lower into a lunge, then explosively jump, without switching legs mid-air, landing softly in the same position. Keep your core tight and maintain balance throughout each jump.

lessons.title: Barbell Good Morning
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, barbell resting on your upper back. Keep a slight bend in knees and engage core. Hinge at the hips, lowering torso forward while maintaining a straight back. Return to standing by driving hips forward, squeezing glutes at the top with control.

lessons.title: Banded Good Morning
lessons.details: Stand on a resistance band, feet shoulder-width apart, band held over shoulders. Keep a slight bend in knees and core engaged. Hinge at hips, lowering torso forward while keeping back straight. Return to standing by driving hips forward, squeezing glutes at the top with controlled movement.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Lateral Lunge
lessons.details: Stand tall, step one foot wide to the side, bending that knee while keeping the other leg straight. Push hips back, chest up, and weight on the bent leg’s heel. Push off to return to start. Repeat on the other side.

lessons.title: Unilateral Overhead Lunge
lessons.details: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell overhead in one hand, keeping your arm locked out and core braced. Step forward into a lunge, lowering until both knees are bent at 90 degrees. Push back up to standing, maintaining overhead stability throughout.

lessons.title: Lateral Box Step Down
lessons.details: Stand beside a bench or box. Step sideways onto it with your outer foot, driving through the heel to lift your body up. Bring the trailing leg to meet the lead leg, then step back down with control. Repeat on both sides.

lessons.title: Lateral Step Up
lessons.details: Stand beside a bench or box. Step sideways onto it with your outer foot, driving through the heel to lift your body up. Bring the trailing leg to meet the lead leg, then step back down with control. Repeat on both sides.

lessons.title: Goblet Lateral Lunge
lessons.details: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at your chest. Step one leg out to the side, bending the knee while keeping the other leg straight. Lower your hips, then push through the bent leg to return to standing.

lessons.title: Switch Arm Kettlebell Swing
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hinge at the hips, and swing the kettlebell to chest height with one arm. At the top, switch hands smoothly, then let it swing back down between your legs and repeat.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Swing
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, grip the kettlebell with both hands, hinge at the hips, and swing it between your legs. Drive through your hips to swing it to chest height, keeping your core braced and back straight.

lessons.title: Barbell Sumo Squat
lessons.details: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes slightly pointed out. Hold a barbell across your upper back or in front rack. Engage core, bend knees, and lower hips into a squat, keeping chest up. Push through heels to rise, maintaining control and proper alignment throughout.

lessons.title: Goblet Sumo Squat
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell close to your chest, stand with feet wider than shoulder-width and toes slightly out. Lower into a squat by pushing hips back and keeping chest tall, then drive through heels to stand tall.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Bulgarian Split Squat
lessons.details: Stand in a split stance with back foot on a bench and front foot firmly on the ground. Lower hips until front thigh is parallel to the floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged. Push through front heel to return to start. Switch legs and repeat.

lessons.title: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
lessons.details: Stand in a split stance with back foot on a bench, holding a barbell across your upper back. Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping front knee over ankle. Press through the front heel to rise, maintaining balance, upright torso, and core engagement throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
lessons.details: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell in front of thighs. Keep knees slightly bent and core engaged. Hinge at the hips, lowering the bar along legs while maintaining a flat back. Squeeze glutes to return to standing. Control movement and avoid rounding the spine.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Step Up
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell at chest level in a goblet position, place one foot firmly on a box or bench, and drive through the heel to step up. Bring the other leg up, then lower slowly and repeat.

lessons.title: Step Up
lessons.details: Place one foot firmly on a box or bench, drive through the heel to lift your body up, bringing the opposite knee up or stepping fully onto the surface. Lower with control and repeat on the other side.

lessons.title: Box Step Up with Knee Drive
lessons.details: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench. Step onto it with one foot, driving the opposite knee upward as you rise. Step back down with control and alternate legs. Keep core engaged and torso upright throughout.

lessons.title: Lateral Step Up
lessons.details: Stand beside a bench or box. Step sideways onto it with your outer foot, driving through the heel to lift your body up. Bring the trailing leg to meet the lead leg, then step back down with control. Repeat on both sides.

lessons.title: Goblet Lunge with Twist
lessons.details: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest in a goblet position. Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor. At the bottom, twist your torso outwards over the front leg, keeping hips forwards and twisting the torso only. Return to center, push back up, and alternate sides.

lessons.title: Heels Elevated Glute Bridge Hold
lessons.details: Lie on your back with knees bent, heels on an elevated surface. Engage core and press through heels to lift hips until body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees. Squeeze glutes and hold at the top, keeping hips stable and breathing steady.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Hip Thrust
lessons.details: Lie with your upper back against a mat, knees bent, feet flat. Brace core, squeeze glutes, and drive hips upward until thighs are parallel to the ground. Lower slowly, keeping tension on glutes.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Double Leg Hip Thrust
lessons.details: Sit with your upper back against a bench, feet flat on the floor, and knees bent. Drive through your heels to lift hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees. Squeeze glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Single Leg Hip Thrust
lessons.details: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat on the floor, and the other leg off the ground. Drive through your grounded heel to lift your hips, keeping your body in a straight line from shoulders to knee. Lower slowly and repeat.

lessons.title: Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
lessons.details: Sit with upper back against a mat, knees bent, heels on an elevated surface. Engage core and drive through heels, lifting hips until torso and thighs align. Squeeze glutes at the top, then lower with control.

lessons.title: Single Leg Elevated Glute Bridge Hold
lessons.details: Lie on your back with one foot on an elevated surface and the other leg unsupported. Press through the elevated foot to lift your hips, forming a straight line from shoulders to the extended foot. Hold, keeping your core tight and glutes engaged.

lessons.title: Single Leg Elevated Hip Thrust
lessons.details: In a lyinhg position, place one foot on a bench or elevated surface and the other leg off the ground. Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knee. Lower slowly.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Single Leg Glute Bridge Hold
lessons.details: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg extended straight. Press through your heel to lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from shoulders to extended foot. Hold, keeping your core tight and glutes engaged.

lessons.title: Single Leg Barbell Hip Thrust
lessons.details: Sit with your upper back against a bench, barbell across your hips, and one foot planted on the ground. Lift hips by driving through the heel, extending until hips are level, while the other leg stays raised. Lower with control.

lessons.title: Single Leg Elevated Kettlebell Hip Thrust
lessons.details: Place your upper back on a bench, one foot on the floor, the other leg extended. Hold a kettlebell on your working hip or hip line, whichever is most comfortable. Take care not to lift with your arms - hands are for support only! Drive through the grounded foot, lifting your hips until your body forms a straight line. Lower slowly and repeat. Switch legs.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Hip Thrust Pulse
lessons.details: Lie on a mat, with feet flat and knees bent. Lift hips until torso and thighs form a line, then perform one 'pulse' half-rep alternating with one full rep. Keep glutes engaged throughout.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Elevated Hip Thrust Pulse
lessons.details: Sit with upper back against a bench, feet on an elevated surface, holding a weight across hips. Lift hips into a bridge, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees. Perform one full rep followed by one half-rep, keeping glutes engaged and core tight. Control movement and avoid sagging.

lessons.title: Hamstring Glute Bridge March
lessons.details: Lie on your back, heels dug in, hips lifted into a bridge. Alternate lifting each knee toward your chest while keeping hips high and glutes engaged. Lower each foot back before switching sides.

lessons.title: Lunge with Knee Drive & Calf Raise
lessons.details: Step into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground. Drive through the front heel to stand, bringing the back knee up toward your chest, then rise onto the ball of the front foot for a calf raise.

lessons.title: Lunge with Knee Drive
lessons.details: Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground. Push through your front heel to rise, driving the back knee up explosively toward your chest. Maintain balance and core engagement. Repeat on both sides for strength and stability.

lessons.title: Wall Sit with Calf Raise
lessons.details: Sit against a wall with knees at 90 degrees. Hold the position and lift your heels off the ground, rising onto your toes, then lower back down. Repeat while keeping your back flat against the wall.

lessons.title: Wall Sit
lessons.details: Lean against a wall with feet shoulder-width apart and about two feet from the wall. Slide down until thighs are parallel to the floor, knees over ankles. Hold the position, keeping back flat and core engaged.

lessons.title: Single Leg Wall Sit
lessons.details: Find your balance in a normal double-legged wall sit first. Raise one leg and hold this position, keeping your core engaged and back pressed against the wall.

lessons.title: Twisting Wall Sit
lessons.details: Sit against a wall with knees at 90 degrees, feet flat. Engage your core and slowly twist your torso to one side, then return to center. Alternate sides while keeping your back and thighs pressed firmly against the wall.

lessons.title: Twisting Wall Sit with Weight
lessons.details: Sit against a wall with knees at 90 degrees, holding a weight outstretched at chest level. Twist your torso slowly to one side, then back to center, engaging your core. Alternate twists while keeping thighs and back pressed against the wall.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Glute Bridge Hold
lessons.details: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor. Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees. Squeeze your glutes and hold the position, keeping your core engaged.

lessons.title: Reverse Lunge with Twist
lessons.details: Step back into a reverse lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground. Rotate your torso toward your front leg, engaging your core. Return to standing and repeat on the other side, keeping movements controlled and stable.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Lunge with Twist
lessons.details: Stand tall and step one foot forward into a lunge, keeping front knee over ankle. Lower back knee toward the floor, then twist your torso toward the front leg. Return to center and step back. Alternate sides, maintaining balance, engaged core, and controlled movement throughout.

lessons.title: Air Squat
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out. Lower your hips by bending your knees and pushing them outward, keeping your chest up and back straight. Lower until thighs are parallel to the floor, then push through your heels to return to standing. Maintain control throughout.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Squat Pulse
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, chest up, and core engaged. Lower into a squat, and perform one half-rep in between each full rep. Keep weight in your heels, knees tracking over toes, and movements smooth. Maintain squat depth throughout.

lessons.title: Lunge with Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand tall, step one foot forward into a lunge, keeping front knee over ankle. Lower back knee toward the floor, then push through the front heel to rise. At the full extent of the lunge, lift the heel of the front foot into a calf raise. Return to start and switch sides, maintaining balance and control.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Lateral Lunge
lessons.details: Stand tall, step one foot wide to the side, bending that knee while keeping the other leg straight. Push hips back, chest up, and weight on the bent leg’s heel. Push off to return to start. Repeat on the other side.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Single Leg Box Squat
lessons.details: Stand on one leg in front of a box or bench. Lower yourself slowly by bending the knee and hip, keeping your chest upright, until you lightly touch the box. Push through your heel to return to standing, maintaining balance and control.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Box Squat
lessons.details: Stand in front of a box or bench. Sit back slowly until your glutes touch the box, keeping chest up and knees over toes. Push through your heels to stand back up.

lessons.title: Prisoner Squat
lessons.details: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped behind your head. Keep chest up and elbows wide. Lower into a squat by pushing hips back and bending knees. Drive through heels to return to standing, maintaining an upright torso throughout.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Lunge Pulse
lessons.details: Start in a lunge with front knee over ankle, back knee just above the floor. Keep torso upright, core tight. Complete a full lunge with a half-lunge in between as a "pulse" to extend the amount of time under tension. Maintain control, avoid bouncing, and repeat.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Squat Calf Raise
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out. Lower into a squat by bending knees and pushing hips back. As you rise, press through the balls of your feet to lift heels into a calf raise. Lower heels and repeat, keeping core engaged and movements controlled.

lessons.title: Cossack Squat
lessons.details: Stand with feet wide apart, toes slightly out. Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee while keeping the other leg straight and foot flat or heel down. Keep chest tall, then push through the bent leg to return to center and repeat on the other side.

lessons.title: Banded Squat
lessons.details: Stand on a resistance band, feet shoulder-width apart, holding handles or band at shoulders. Engage core and glutes, lowering into a squat by bending knees and pushing hips back. Keep chest up and knees aligned with toes. Press through heels to return to standing with control.

lessons.title: Goblet Squat
lessons.details: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, lower your hips back and down into a squat, keeping your chest up and knees tracking over toes. Press through your heels to return to standing.

lessons.title: Goblet Squat with Calf Raise
lessons.details: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height in a hoblet position. Squat down, keeping chest up and knees over toes. As you rise, press through your toes to lift heels into a calf raise. Lower back down slowly and repeat with controlled motion.

lessons.title: Goblet Lunge with Twist
lessons.details: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest in a goblet position. Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor. At the bottom, twist your torso outwards over the front leg, keeping hips forwards and twisting the torso only. Return to center, push back up, and alternate sides.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Swing
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, grip the kettlebell with both hands, hinge at the hips, and swing it between your legs. Drive through your hips to swing it to chest height, keeping your core braced and back straight.

lessons.title: Switch Arm Kettlebell Swing
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hinge at the hips, and swing the kettlebell to chest height with one arm. At the top, switch hands smoothly, then let it swing back down between your legs and repeat.

lessons.title: Single Kettlebell Clean and Press
lessons.details: Start with a kettlebell between your feet. Hinge at the hips, grab the bell, and drive through your legs to clean it to shoulder height. From here, press overhead, locking out your arm. Lower with control and repeat for power and coordination.

lessons.title: Barbell Back Squat
lessons.details: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, barbell resting on upper back. Engage core, keep chest up, and gaze forward. Bend knees and hips to lower into a squat, keeping weight on heels. Push through heels to return to standing, maintaining controlled movement and proper alignment throughout.

lessons.title: Barbell Front Load Squat
lessons.details: Hold a barbell at shoulder height, elbows up, chest tall - this can be with a regular or a crossed grip. Step feet shoulder-width apart, squat down by pushing hips back and bending knees, keeping weight on heels. Drive through heels to return to standing, maintaining an upright torso throughout.

lessons.title: Back Extension Machine
lessons.details: Adjust the pad to align with your hips, position your feet securely, and cross your arms over your chest. Lower your torso slowly, then extend your back to lift your chest until aligned with your legs. Avoid hyperextending.

lessons.title: Cable Hip Abduction Machine
lessons.details: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable. Stand sideways to the machine, strap around the outer ankle. Keeping the supporting leg slightly bent, lift the strapped leg outward against resistance. Control the return and repeat for desired reps.

lessons.title: Cable Machine Kickbacks
lessons.details: Attach an ankle strap to the cable machine at the lowest setting. Face the machine, hinge slightly forward, and extend one leg straight back against resistance. Control the return and repeat before switching sides. Engages glutes and hamstrings.

lessons.title: Hip Abduction Machine
lessons.details: Sit on the hip abduction machine with your back supported and feet on the pads. Begin with knees together, then press your legs outward against resistance. Control the return inward to keep tension on the muscles. Targets glutes and outer thighs.

lessons.title: Hip Adduction Machine
lessons.details: Sit on the hip adduction machine with your back against the pad and feet secured on the footrests. Start with legs apart, then squeeze your thighs together against the resistance. Slowly return to the starting position with control.

lessons.title: Leg Press Machine
lessons.details: Sit on the leg press machine with your back against the pad and feet shoulder-width on the platform. Push the platform away by extending your legs, then slowly lower it back without locking your knees. Maintain control and engage your legs throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Reverse Sled Drag
lessons.details: Face the sled, grab the straps or handles, and step backward with knees slightly bent and chest tall. Drive through your legs to pull the sled toward you, keeping tension on the straps throughout.

lessons.title: Single Leg Press Machine
lessons.details: Sit on a leg press machine and place one foot centered on the platform. Keep your other leg relaxed. Push through your heel to extend the working leg without locking the knee, then slowly return under control. Maintain steady breathing and core engagement.

lessons.title: Sled Push
lessons.details: Stand behind the sled with hands on the handles, body leaning slightly forward, and core tight. Drive through your legs to push the sled forward with powerful, steady strides. Maintain control and consistent effort throughout.

lessons.title: Alternating Bodyweight Backwards Lunge
lessons.details: Step one leg back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor. Push through the front heel to return to standing, then switch legs, alternating each step. Keep your torso upright and core engaged throughout.

lessons.title: Alternating Bodyweight Forwards Lunge
lessons.details: Step forward with one leg into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor. Push through the front heel to return and switch legs, alternating each step. Keep your torso upright and core engaged.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Alternating Lunge
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell in one hand at chest level or by your side. Step forward into a lunge, keeping chest tall and core engaged. Push through the front heel to return to standing, then alternate legs. Maintain balance, controlled movement, and steady breathing throughout.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Backwards Lunge
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell one of both hands. Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor while keeping your front knee over your ankle. Push through the front heel to return to standing, maintaining balance and control.

lessons.title: Reverse Bodyweight Lunge with Twist
lessons.details: Step back into a reverse lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground. Rotate your torso toward your front leg, engaging your core. Return to standing and repeat on the other side, keeping movements controlled and stable.

lessons.title: Reverse Goblet Lunge with Twist
lessons.details: Step back into a reverse lunge while holding a weight at your chest. Twist your torso toward the front leg, engaging your core. Return to standing and repeat on the other side, maintaining balance and control throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
lessons.details: Stand in a split stance with back foot on a bench, holding a barbell across your upper back. Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping front knee over ankle. Press through the front heel to rise, maintaining balance, upright torso, and core engagement throughout the movement.

lessons.title: Split Squat Pulse
lessons.details: Start in a split squat position with one foot forward and the other back. Lower into the squat and do one half-rep in between each full rep. Keep your chest tall, core engaged, and weight in the front heel. Repeat before switching legs.

lessons.title: Barbell Split Squat
lessons.details: Stand in a split stance with one foot forward and the other back, holding a barbell across your shoulders. Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright, then drive through your front heel to return to start. Maintain balance and control throughout

lessons.title: Bosu Ball Split Squat
lessons.details: Place your rear foot on a BOSU ball and front foot firmly on the floor. Lower into a split squat by bending your front knee while keeping chest tall. Push through the front heel to rise back up, maintaining balance and control.

lessons.title: Front Leg Elevated Goblet Split Squat
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell at chest level in a goblet position. Place your front foot on an elevated surface, lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright, then drive through the front heel to return to standing.

lessons.title: Front Leg Elevated Split Squat
lessons.details: Place front foot on an elevated surface and back foot on the ground. Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping chest upright, then press through the front heel to return to standing

lessons.title: Plyometric Split Squat
lessons.details: Start in a split stance with one foot forward, one back. Lower into a lunge, then explosively jump, without switching legs mid-air, landing softly in the same position. Keep your core tight and maintain balance throughout each jump.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Split Squat
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your side. Step one leg back into a split squat, lowering until front knee is over ankle. Push through the front heel to rise, keeping chest tall and core engaged. Switch sides with control.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Bulgarian Split Squat
lessons.details: Stand in a split stance with back foot on a bench and front foot firmly on the ground. Lower hips until front thigh is parallel to the floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged. Push through front heel to return to start. Switch legs and repeat.

lessons.title: Bodyweight Curtsy Lunge
lessons.details: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart. Step one leg diagonally behind the other into a curtsy position, bending both knees to lower hips. Keep chest upright and core engaged. Push through the front foot to return to start. Strengthens glutes, quads, inner thighs, and improves balance and hip stability.

lessons.title: Goblet Curtsy Lunge
lessons.details: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest. Step one leg diagonally behind you into a curtsy position, bending both knees. Lower your hips, then push through your front foot to return to standing. Alternate sides.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Curtsy Lunge
lessons.details: Stand tall holding kettlebells at your sides. Step one leg diagonally behind the other into a curtsy lunge, lowering until front thigh is parallel to the floor. Push through the front heel to return to start. Alternate legs, keeping chest up, core engaged, and movements controlled.

lessons.title: Unilateral Overhead Lunge
lessons.details: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell overhead in one hand, keeping your arm locked out and core braced. Step forward into a lunge, lowering until both knees are bent at 90 degrees. Push back up to standing, maintaining overhead stability throughout.

lessons.title: Goblet Lateral Lunge
lessons.details: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at your chest. Step one leg out to the side, bending the knee while keeping the other leg straight. Lower your hips, then push through the bent leg to return to standing.

lessons.title: Barbell Sumo Squat
lessons.details: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes slightly pointed out. Hold a barbell across your upper back or in front rack. Engage core, bend knees, and lower hips into a squat, keeping chest up. Push through heels to rise, maintaining control and proper alignment throughout.

lessons.title: Goblet Sumo Squat
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell close to your chest, stand with feet wider than shoulder-width and toes slightly out. Lower into a squat by pushing hips back and keeping chest tall, then drive through heels to stand tall.

lessons.title: Step Up
lessons.details: Place one foot firmly on a box or bench, drive through the heel to lift your body up, bringing the opposite knee up or stepping fully onto the surface. Lower with control and repeat on the other side.

lessons.title: Slow Eccentric Lateral Step Downs
lessons.details: Stand on a box or step with one foot planted and the other hanging off the side. Slowly lower the hanging foot toward the ground by bending the standing leg, then return to the start with control.

lessons.title: Box Step Up with Knee Drive
lessons.details: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench. Step onto it with one foot, driving the opposite knee upward as you rise. Step back down with control and alternate legs. Keep core engaged and torso upright throughout.

lessons.title: Kettlebell Step Up
lessons.details: Hold a kettlebell at chest level in a goblet position, place one foot firmly on a box or bench, and drive through the heel to step up. Bring the other leg up, then lower slowly and repeat.

lessons.title: Lateral Box Step Down
lessons.details: Stand beside a bench or box. Step sideways onto it with your outer foot, driving through the heel to lift your body up. Bring the trailing leg to meet the lead leg, then step back down with control. Repeat on both sides.

lessons.title: Lateral Step Up
lessons.details: Stand beside a bench or box. Step sideways onto it with your outer foot, driving through the heel to lift your body up. Bring the trailing leg to meet the lead leg, then step back down with control. Repeat on both sides.

lessons.title: Lateral Powerbag Step Up
lessons.details: Stand side-on to a box or bench holding the powerbag tight at your chest (or on one shoulder). Place the foot closest to the box on top with your knee tracking over your toes, brace your core, then drive through that whole foot to step up powerfully and stand tall. Step back down under control to the same side, repeat for reps, then turn around and do the other side.

lessons.title: Front Step Downs
lessons.details: Stand on a raised platform with one foot, step forward and down slowly, keeping the other foot off the ground. Maintain control and balance, then return to start and switch legs. Focus on engaging quads and glutes throughout.

lessons.title: Side Step Downs
lessons.details: Stand on a step or platform with one foot. Slowly lower the opposite foot toward the ground by bending the standing leg, keeping control. Lightly tap the foot down, then press through the elevated foot to return to start. Maintain balance and avoid leaning forward.

lessons.title: Powerbag Squat: Front and Back Loaded
lessons.details: Hold the powerbag either in front of your chest (front-loaded) or on your upper back (back-loaded). Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, squat down by pushing hips back and bending knees, then drive through your heels to return to standing. Keep your chest up and core engaged.

lessons.title: Lunge with Knee Drive & Calf Raise

lessons.title: Lunge with Knee Drive
lessons.details: Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground. Push through your front heel to rise, driving the back knee up explosively toward your chest. Maintain balance and core engagement. Repeat on both sides for strength and stability.

lessons.title: Wall Sit with Calf Raise
lessons.details: Sit against a wall with knees at 90 degrees. Hold the position and lift your heels off the ground, rising onto your toes, then lower back down. Repeat while keeping your back flat against the wall.

lessons.title: Wall Sit
lessons.details: Lean against a wall with feet shoulder-width apart and about two feet from the wall. Slide down until thighs are parallel to the floor, knees over ankles. Hold the position, keeping back flat and core engaged.

lessons.title: Single Leg Wall Sit

lessons.title: Twisting Wall Sit

lessons.title: Reverse Bodyweight Lunge with Twist

lessons.title: Prisoner Squat

lessons.title: Banded Squat
lessons.details: Stand on a resistance band, feet shoulder-width apart, holding handles or band at shoulders. Engage core and glutes, lowering into a squat by bending knees and pushing hips back. Keep chest up and knees aligned with toes. Press through heels to return to standing with control.

lessons.title: Seated Banded Knee Extension
lessons.details: Sit on a chair with a resistance band looped around your ankle and anchored behind. Start with your knee bent at 90 degrees. Extend your leg forward against the band until straight, then slowly return to the starting position. Repeat for controlled reps.

lessons.title: Goblet Squat

lessons.title: Goblet Squat with Calf Raise

lessons.title: Goblet Sumo Squat

lessons.title: Barbell Back Squat

Push through heels to return to standing, maintaining controlled movement and proper alignment throughout.

lessons.title: Leg Extension Machine
lessons.details: Sit on the leg extension machine with your knees aligned to the pivot point and the pad just above your ankles. Grip the handles, then extend your legs until straight. Slowly lower back down with control, keeping tension in your quads throughout.

lessons.title: Leg Press Machine

lessons.title: Reverse Sled Drag

lessons.title: Single Leg Press Machine

lessons.title: Weighted Wall Sit
lessons.details: Sit against a wall with knees at 90 degrees, holding a weight on your thighs. Keep your back flat, core engaged, and hold the position, ensuring your quads do the work. Breathe steadily throughout the hold.

lessons.title: Reverse Goblet Lunge with Twist

lessons.title: Kettlebell Alternating Lunge

lessons.details: Stand tall holding kettlebells at your sides. Step one leg diagonally behind the other into a curtsy lunge, lowering until front thigh is parallel to the floor. Push through the front heel to return to start. Alternate legs, keeping chest up, core engaged, and movements controlled.
